text.p: - Offices of a Slovenian minority magazine in Klagenfurt in Austria were looted and burned to the ground on Wednesday. No one has claimed responsibility for the attack but police have not ruled out political motives.
- Representatives of Slovenian employers and trade unions said on Wednesday that the collective agreement determining worker's benefits should be changed at the latest by the end of May 1997.
- Slovenia's Smelt Olimpija beat French Asvel 73-60 in Wednesday's basketball EuroLeague C group match.
- The number of financial crimes in Slovenia in the first nine months exceeded 3,000 a four percent increase on the same period last year, Slovenian Police said on Wednesday.
- Electricity prices in Slovenia will rise 3.5 percent on Thursday.
- Slovenian Railways said on Wednesday a strike of Croatian railway workers costs the organisation 11.2 million tolars ($78,873) daily.
- More than 300 experts are taking part in Slovenia's first wine-growing congress that started on Wednesday in coastal city of Portoroz.
